description: AICTIONBOT™ AI readiness check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit templates T28 (AI assessment) and T26 (digital transformation). Takes ratings from 1 (does not apply) to 5 (fully applies) for eight fields: goal, process, data_quality, data_access, ownership, skills, tools, risk. Returns the average, the level (foundations missing, fix the foundation first, pilot possible, ready to scale), the weakest fields and one concrete next step for the weakest. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

answers.description: Ratings 1 to 5 for goal, process, data_quality, data_access, ownership, skills, tools, risk (at least four).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: ai_readiness
